reviewer.auth: ChatGPT login (not re-verified for this unit beyond the successful run)
reviewer.mode: codex exec -c sandbox_mode="read-only" with the diff supplied on stdin; the command host is not installed, so the reviewer could not run commands or tests

attempts.scope: working-tree diff of intent/mitt_tracking.py (match_template extraction), new intent/mitt_reacquire.py, new intent/mitt_reacquire_pilot.py, new tests/test_mitt_reacquire.py, new tests/test_mitt_reacquire_pilot.py, scripts/check_project.py lint list; not the docs or results

findings.claim: appearance cut between two consecutive search frames is missed when both frames stay within the threshold of the frozen anchor
findings.disposition: accepted; the consecutive-frame check (same threshold as PatchTracker) is applied in addition to the anchor check; regression test with the reviewer's opposing-brightness sequence

findings.claim: malformed reacquire_candidate_px ([-1,160], [], NaN) passes outside the candidate state because both sides of the equivalence are False
findings.disposition: accepted; candidate state requires a finite point and every other state requires None; regression test over four malformed values in both states

findings.claim: a candidate rejection on the exhausting frame is counted as an abstention
findings.disposition: accepted; classified by reason prefix; synthetic row test. No such case occurred in the real 625-frame replay (candidates 21 = accepted 16 + rejected 5 before and after the fix)

findings.claim: only part of each row (state keys and current_candidate) is compared, so a changed history or event count passes
findings.disposition: accepted; whole rows including the stationary snapshot are compared; test tampers events_total and last_historical_candidate

findings.claim: a rejection on the confirmation frame after the last search frame raises the window count beyond max_attempt_frames and the pilot reports it as an attempt
findings.disposition: accepted; the count no longer exceeds the budget, a reacquire_searched flag marks real match calls and the pilot reports window_frames and search_frames separately (real replay: 53 window frames, 48 searches)

no_defect_areas: segment isolation / candidate clearing / frozen events / segment id order
base-regression projection, denominators, visible report paths (provenance helpers not in scope)

attempts.scope: fix-only diff of intent/mitt_reacquire.py, intent/mitt_reacquire_pilot.py, tests/test_mitt_reacquire.py, tests/test_mitt_reacquire_pilot.py between the attempt-a state and the working tree
attempts.reported: all five findings resolved; no new concrete defect identified in the supplied diff

fix: all five findings fixed in the working tree before the first commit of this unit; the real-data replay was rerun after the fixes (v2) and its 625 rows equal the pre-fix replay (v1) in state, reason, points, segments and stationary outputs
review_status: closed: attempt a findings fixed, attempt b confirmed resolution with no new defect; the reviewed working tree is the content of this unit's first commit (SHA on the board closing record)
